original_bug_description: A global-buffer-overflow (out-of-bounds read) occurs in xmlDictComputeFastKey / xmlDictLookup (dict.c) when handling NCName/QName parsing (xmlParseNCName / xmlParseQName in parser.c). The code reads one byte past a global string literal into adjacent global data (e.g. the xmlIsPubidChar_tab table), causing an out-of-bounds read that can crash the parser or expose unintended memory during XML parsing.
normalized_bug_description: https://oss-fuzz.com/testcase?key=5172704131809280: libxml2 has a reported memory-safety bug. A global-buffer-overflow (out-of-bounds read) occurs in xmlDictComputeFastKey / xmlDictLookup (dict.c) when handling NCName/QName parsing (xmlParseNCName / xmlParseQName in parser.c). The code reads one byte past a global string literal into adjacent global data (e.g. the xmlIsPubidChar_tab table), causing an out-of-bounds read that can crash the parser or expose unintended memory during XML parsing.
